description: What Watches in Stock has published about itself, and its market knowledge. Its own answers: how to buy (only through a dealer authorized by Watches in Stock, who gives a login, which is also the answer for deposits, payment, shipping, returns and warranty), authenticity, prices, availability, selling, consignment, where listings come from, currency and customer details; for gift wrap, engraving, trade-in, seeing a watch in person, sending a watch you sell, financing or price alerts it says what is published. Its market knowledge, one topic per subject, each with what to say, what to avoid and an example: other_sites (another site or marketplace, or its price); fair_price (what to pay, is the price right, it seems expensive); not_found (is it available, why isn't it showing); how_to_buy (how to buy, who sells); payment_and_after_sale (payment, escrow, shipping, warranty, refunds, problems); selling_a_watch (selling one, what it would fetch); trust (genuine, replicas, fakes, trusting the dealers); dealers_join (how dealers join, dealer fees); international_buyers (outside the US, shipping abroad, duties, customs, luggage); boutique_and_premium (a boutique wait list, the premium over retail, certified pre-owned); unworn (unworn against worn); budget (only a budget, no model yet); investment (value over time, investment); service (servicing, polishing, their cost); identity (owners, team, offices, people, looking someone up); full_set (box, papers, completing a set, box prices); listing_terms (WT, white tag, stickers, +label, W&C); implausible_price (a price or year far outside the market); sign_up (accounts, sign-up, access); what_is_wis (what Watches in Stock is, does it sell watches); asia (Asia, Hong Kong prices); no_data (anything not covered here); direct_answers (ordinary questions about a listing); human_or_ai (a person, an AI, a joke, do you know watches). Use it for questions about the business, buying or the market rather than one watch.
